runtimes: Linux kernel with required eBPF capabilities

observation.coverage_basis: Kernel metadata can assist workload and dependency discovery; it does not expose prompts, tool meaning, policy verdicts, or an agent decision boundary.

authentication.credential_handling: No implementation ships; any future exporter must define credentials and workload binding explicitly.

correlation_limitations: Encrypted traffic prevents reliable application payload or trace-header inspection.
Process, socket, and file metadata cannot establish causal agent decision or tool semantics.

verification_evidence.claim: Illustrative contract only; no eBPF connector implementation or verification evidence ships.

known_blind_spots: Cannot identify prompts, completions, tool arguments, tool results, policy verdicts, or decision boundaries.
Cannot reliably distinguish an autonomous agent from a conventional process using the same network services.
Requires privileged kernel visibility and creates an additional host security and privacy review surface.
This manifest is illustrative and does not represent a released SingleAxis component.
